tags.name: Interactable
tags.rule: A character with the Interact tag can turn it on and off.

tags.name: Walk
tags.rule: Can move on front, back, left or right cell.

tags.name: Throw
tags.rule: Throw a stone on a valid Stone Target within range.

tags.name: Threat
tags.rule: Kills an eligible target found in the Threat Area.

tags.name: Fears Light
tags.rule: Disappears when inside a Light area.

tags.name: Light source
tags.rule: Repels rats within the zone range.

tags.name: Prey
tags.rule: When eaten by a Rat, destroys all adjacent connected Rats.

tags.name: Can Interact
tags.rule: Eligible for Interact with objects with that tag.

tags.name: Trigger
tags.rule: Can Trigger a linked triggerable object in the Level.

tags.name: Triggerable
tags.rule: Can be triggered by a linked Trigger object.

tags.name: Lightable
tags.rule: Can be lit when the Player uses it on a Fire Source.

tags.name: Usable
tags.rule: Can be used by the player.

tags.name: Breaks Lanterns
tags.rule: Turns light objects off when it's placed on their node.

tags.name: Stone Target
tags.rule: Can be targeted for a stone throw.
